shared_before.scope: Mock provider: first partial at 80ms, final 400ms later. Real single-flight engine; excludes network, OCR and rendering.

thread_scope: 0.01.22 only; 1/2/4/8 regional workers, whole-frame discovery unchanged, 6 measured runs per scene after warmup; refinement crop cache cleared per call. Direct helper timings exclude IPC and geometry postprocessing. All text/box output hashes identical.
historical_feedback: Earlier user feedback described fragmented text, unstable layout and scene-specific rules. This is a scenario-adaptation risk, not a demonstrated trained-model overfitting result. No cross-game holdout evaluation was performed.
